status: Local protocol fixed before evaluating hash ranks 28000:36000; not public preregistration
model: RF120 trained only on previous strong-cohort training rows, reusing previous validation-selected parameters. Three-seed mean. No new tuning.
primary: Delay-weighted recent negative tail versus identical unweighted recent pool: paired day-bootstrap recall and FPR deltas. Success requires positive recall interval with no FPR increase and observed FPR <=5% in every fold.
availability: Label revealed at migration+3600, a conservative operational assumption rather than verified data-publication time. Current-token and equal-decision-time labels are never used. Oracle violates maturity and is explicitly invalid for deployment.
scope: Same historical MELT period, disjoint eventual migrants; price-collapse proxy, not fraud. Estimated weighting has no conformal guarantee; fixed 36h buffer is audited, not assumed universally complete. No global novelty claim.
